**Result: Compliant — no redline proposed.**

MINCOMMIT is satisfied at the **preferred** level, not merely the fallback:

| Preferred element | Where met |
|---|---|
| No minimum purchase or volume commitment | § 2.1: "No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies." |
| Customer pays only for usage or ordered Services | § 2.1: "Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form" |

Supporting protections that close off indirect commitments: § 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges no minimum-volume commitment), § 7.1 (no undisclosed minimum-use charges), § 1.9 (quantities only via signed Order Form), § 8.2–8.3 (opt-out renewal, capped uplift, no ratchet), and § 9.4 (without-cause exit, only accrued Fees, prepaid Fees refunded).

Because the preferred elements are met on the face of the document, I did not upgrade or add fallback true-up/reduction mechanics, and I avoided double-flagging § 7.7 (late-payment liquidated damages — a payment-terms rule) and the § 9.4 exit economics (termination-for-convenience rule).
